name: hou_mcp_architectural_review
description: Tier 10.5 — Architecture quality review. Accepts plan_json and shell_json and validates: all door anchors have openings, all window anchors have openings, fireplaces are wall-attached, beams are below ceiling and clear of walls, no floating shelves. Outputs ARCHITECTURE_STATUS (PASS / FAIL), ARCHITECTURE_SCORE, and ARCHITECTURE_REPORT.
